source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 19 (PDF 115-154), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 19 (Chromosome and DNA) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Chromosomes were first discovered in the rapidly dividing cells of salamander larvae by:
(Salamander larvae ke tezi se taqseem hone wale cells mein chromosomes sab se pehle kis ne daryaft kiye?)
blocks.explanation: German embryologist Walther Flemming ne 1882 mein salamander larvae ke cells mein chromosomes daryaft kiye.

book_ref.quote: Chromosomes were discovered by a German embryologist, Walther Flemming in 1882

blocks.prompt:
2 The word "chromosome", proposed by Waldeyer-Hartz in 1888, literally means:
(Lafz "chromosome" (jo Waldeyer-Hartz ne 1888 mein diya) ka lafzi matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: "Chromosome" ka lafzi matlab rangeen ajsaam (coloured bodies) hai; yeh naam Waldeyer-Hartz ne 1888 mein diya.

book_ref.quote: literally means coloured bodies

blocks.prompt:
3 The complete set of chromosomes of a species, with its particular number and shape, is called:
(Kisi species ke chromosomes ka poora set, apni khaas tadaad aur shakal ke saath, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har species mein chromosomes ki tadaad aur shakal mukhtalif hai; is poore set ko karyotype kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: This complete set is called the karyotype

blocks.prompt:
4 In somatic cells of diploid organisms, chromosomes occur in pairs called:
(Diploid organisms ke somatic (jism ke) cells mein chromosomes jin joron mein hote hain unhein kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Diploid organisms ke somatic cells mein chromosomes joron mein hote hain jinhein homologous chromosomes kehte hain; gametes mein aadhe hote hain aur jore nahin hote.

book_ref.quote: These pairs are called homologous chromosomes

blocks.prompt:
5 In a non-dividing (interphase) cell, the uncoiled chromosomes form a fine network called:
(Taqseem na hone wale (interphase) cell mein khule hue chromosomes aik bareek jaal banate hain jise kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Interphase mein chromosomes alag nazar nahin aate; woh khule rehte hain aur bareek jaal banate hain jise chromatin kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: They remain uncoiled and form a fine network, called chromatin

blocks.prompt:
6 After duplication in interphase, the two identical strands of a chromosome attached at the centromere are called:
(Interphase mein duplication ke baad chromosome ki do aik jaisi strands jo centromere par jurri hon, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Duplication ke baad har chromosome do aik jaisi strands par mushtamil hota hai jinhein sister chromatids kehte hain; yeh centromere par jurri hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: These two strands are known as sister chromatids

blocks.prompt:
7 The centromere is a specific DNA sequence of about:
(Centromere taqreeban kitne nucleotides ki khaas DNA sequence hai?)
blocks.explanation: Centromere taqreeban 220 nucleotides ki khaas DNA sequence hai.

book_ref.quote: The centromere is a specific DNA sequence of about 220 nucleotides

blocks.prompt:
8 The disc-shaped protein structure on the centromere, where the chromosome attaches to the mitotic spindle, is the:
(Centromere par lagi disc jaisi protein structure, jahan chromosome mitotic spindle se jurta hai, kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kinetochore centromere se lagi disc jaisi protein structure hai; isi jagah chromosome mitotic spindle se jurta hai.

book_ref.quote: A disc-shaped protein structure, called the kinetochore, is attached to the centromere

blocks.prompt:
9 The secondary constriction or Nuclear Organizer Region (NOR) of a chromosome:
(Chromosome ki secondary constriction ya Nuclear Organizer Region (NOR) kya karti hai?)

options.text: chromosome ko spindle fibres se jorti hai
chromosome ke siron ko jurne se rokti hai

blocks.explanation: Secondary constriction, jise NOR bhi kehte hain, interphase mein nucleoli banati hai.

book_ref.quote: It makes nucleoli during interphase

blocks.prompt:
10 The knob-like end of a chromosome beside the secondary constriction, having highly repetitive DNA, is called:
(Secondary constriction ke saath chromosome ka gol ghundi jaisa sira, jis mein bohat dohrai wali DNA hoti hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secondary constriction ke saath ghundi jaisa sira satellite kehlata hai; is hisse mein bohat dohrai wali DNA (junk DNA) hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The end of chromosome beside secondary constriction is knob-like

blocks.prompt:
11 The function of telomeres is to:
(Telomeres ka kaam kya hai?)

options.text: do chromosomes ko siron se aapas mein jurne se rokna

blocks.explanation: Telomeres chromosomes ke aakhri sire hain; yeh do chromosomes ko apne siron se aapas mein jurne se rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: The terminal ends of chromosomes are called telomeres

blocks.prompt:
12 A chromosome whose centromere lies slightly away from the centre is called:
(Jis chromosome ka centromere markaz se thora hat kar ho, use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Centromere bilkul markaz mein: metacentric; markaz se thora hat kar: sub-metacentric; sire ke qareeb: acrocentric; sire par: telocentric.

book_ref.quote: The ones in which centromere is located slightly away from centre are sub-metacentric chromosomes

blocks.prompt:
13 In which type of chromosome is the centromere located at the very end?
(Kis qisam ke chromosome mein centromere bilkul sire par hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Telocentric chromosomes mein centromere sire par hota hai; acrocentric mein sire ke qareeb.

book_ref.quote: in telocentric chromosomes, centromere is located at the end

blocks.text: 19.1.2 Chemical Composition and Organization of Chromosome

blocks.prompt:
14 The chemical composition of a chromosome is about:
(Chromosome ki kimiyai banawat taqreeban kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chromosome 40% DNA aur 60% proteins (histones) se bana hai.

book_ref.quote: A chromosome is made up of 40% DNA and 60% proteins (histones)

blocks.prompt:
15 The DNA in an average human chromosome is about:
(Aik aam insani chromosome ki DNA taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam insani chromosome ki DNA taqreeban 5 cm lambi hai aur taqreeban 140 million nucleotides par mushtamil hai.

book_ref.quote: The DNA in an average human chromosome is about 5 cm long

blocks.prompt:
16 Histone proteins are positively charged because they are rich in the basic amino acids:
(Histone proteins positive charge wale hain kyun ke un mein kaun se basic amino acids zyada hain?)
blocks.explanation: Histones mein arginine aur lysine jaise basic amino acids zyada hain is liye woh positive hain; DNA (negative) in se mazboot kashish rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: abundance of basic amino acids such as arginine and lysine

blocks.prompt:
17 DNA carries a negative charge because of its:
(DNA par negative charge kis wajah se hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNA mein phosphate groups ki maujoodgi ki wajah se negative charge hota hai.

book_ref.quote: DNA is a negatively charged due to the presence of phosphate groups

blocks.prompt:
18 In a nucleosome, the length of DNA that wraps twice around a histone octamer is approximately:
(Nucleosome mein histone octamer ke gird do dafa lipatne wali DNA taqreeban kitni hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban har 146 nucleotides ki DNA (2 nm moti) histone octamer ke gird do dafa lipat kar nucleosome banati hai.

book_ref.quote: approximately every 146 nucleotides of DNA (2 nm thick) wrap twice around a histone octamer

blocks.prompt:
19 A histone octamer consists of:
(Histone octamer kis cheez par mushtamil hai?)

options.text: H1, H2A, H3 aur H4 ki do do copies
H2A, H2B, H3 aur H4 ki do do copies
H1 aur H3 ki chaar chaar copies

blocks.explanation: Histone octamer 8 histone molecules ka set hai: H2A, H2B, H3 aur H4 ki do do copies.

book_ref.quote: two copies each of the histones H2A, H2B, H3, and H4

blocks.prompt:
20 The linker histone present at the base of the nucleosome near the DNA entry and exit points is:
(Nucleosome ki base par DNA ke dakhil aur kharij hone ki jagah ke qareeb linker histone kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paanchwein qisam ka histone, H1, linker histone hai; yeh nucleosomes ki chain ke lipatne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The fifth type of histone i.e., H1 called linker histone

blocks.prompt:
21 Adjacent nucleosomes are connected by linker DNA about:
(Saath wale nucleosomes kitni lambi linker DNA se jure hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleosomes taqreeban 80 nucleotides lambi linker DNA se jure hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Nucleosomes are connected by about 80 nucleotide long linker DNA

blocks.prompt:
22 The thickness of the nucleosome string is:
(Nucleosome string ki motai kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleosome string 11 nm moti hai; akeli DNA 2 nm aur chromatin fibre 30 nm hai.

book_ref.quote: resemble beads on a string called nucleosome string (11 nm thick)

blocks.prompt:
23 When the nucleosome string coils again in early cell division, the thicker fibre formed is the chromatin fibre of:
(Cell division ke shuru mein nucleosome string dobara lipat kar jo moti fibre banati hai, woh chromatin fibre kitni moti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mazbooti se bandhe nucleosomes moti fibre banate hain jise chromatin fibre (30 nm) kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: make a thicker fibre called chromatin fibre (30 nm)

blocks.prompt:
24 The inactive portions of chromatin that produce dark bands are called:
(Chromatin ke ghair-faal (inactive) hisse jo gehri dhariyan banate hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chromatin ke inactive hisse gehri dhariyan banate hain aur heterochromatin kehlate hain; active hisse euchromatin hain.

book_ref.quote: The inactive portions of chromatin produce dark bands and are called heterochromatin

blocks.prompt:
25 Which shows the correct increasing order of thickness in the organization of a chromosome?
(Chromosome ki tanzeem mein motai ki barhti hui sahi tarteeb kaun si hai?)

options.text: DNA 2 nm, nucleosome string 11 nm, chromatin fibre 30 nm, supercoil 300 nm, chromatid 700 nm
DNA 2 nm, chromatin fibre 11 nm, nucleosome string 30 nm, supercoil 300 nm, chromatid 700 nm
DNA 2 nm, nucleosome string 11 nm, supercoil 30 nm, chromatin fibre 300 nm, chromatid 700 nm
DNA 11 nm, nucleosome string 30 nm, chromatin fibre 300 nm, supercoil 700 nm, chromatid 1400 nm

blocks.explanation: DNA (2 nm) se nucleosome string (11 nm), phir chromatin fibre (30 nm), phir supercoil (300 nm) aur aakhir mein chromatid (700 nm) banta hai.

book_ref.quote: The chromatin fibre folds upon itself to make a supercoil (300 nm thick)

blocks.prompt:
26 The supercoil further coils and condenses into a chromatid, which is:
(Supercoil mazeed lipat kar chromatid banta hai, jo kitna mota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chromatid 700 nm mota hai (book correction: 1,400 nm do chromatids wale poore chromosome ki chaurai hai, aik chromatid ki nahin).

book_ref.quote: takes the shape of chromatid (700 nm thick)

blocks.text: 19.1.3 The Concept of Genes and Alleles

blocks.prompt:
27 The term "gene" for the basic unit of heredity was introduced in 1909 by:
(Wirasat ki bunyadi ikai ke liye lafz "gene" 1909 mein kis ne diya?)
blocks.explanation: 1909 mein Danish botanist Wilhelm Johannsen ne wirasat ki bunyadi ikai ke liye lafz "gene" diya.

book_ref.quote: In 1909, a Danish botanist Wilhelm Johannsen introduced the term

blocks.prompt:
28 Which statement about the DNA of a chromosome is correct?
(Chromosome ki DNA ke bare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Poori DNA molecule amino acids ki tarteeb ka code deti hai
Sirf histones proteins ka code rakhte hain
Sirf telomeres proteins ka code dete hain
Sirf us ke chhote hisse, yani genes, proteins ka code dete hain

blocks.explanation: Chromosome ki poori DNA proteins ka paigham nahin rakhti; sirf chhote hisse jinhein genes kehte hain proteins ka code dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Rather, short segments of DNA, called genes, encode proteins

blocks.prompt:
29 On a pair of homologous chromosomes, the alleles of a gene are present:
(Homologous chromosomes ke jore par aik gene ke alleles kahan hote hain?)

options.text: aik hi chromosome ke mukhtalif loci par

blocks.explanation: Alleles, yani gene ki mutabadil shaklein, homologous chromosomes par aik hi locus (jagah) par hote hain, maslan aankh ke rang ke alleles.

book_ref.quote: the alternate forms of a gene i.e., alleles are present on the same locus

blocks.prompt:
30 Which of the following is NOT a characteristic required of a genetic material?
(In mein se kaun si khasiyat genetic material ke liye zaroori NAHIN?)

options.text: Woh proteins mein amino acids ki tarteeb ka code de
Woh waqt ke saath kabhi na badle
Woh cell division se pehle apni copy banaye
Woh eukaryotic cells ke nucleus mein ho

blocks.explanation: Genetic material ko proteins ka code dena, division se pehle apni copy banana, nucleus mein hona aur waqt ke saath badal sakna chahiye (evolution ke liye); sirf DNA yeh sab poora karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It must be able to change over time to account for evolution

blocks.prompt:
31 How long did it take scientists to settle whether genes are made of DNA, protein or both?
(Scientists ko yeh tay karne mein kitna waqt laga ke genes DNA, protein ya dono se bane hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh sawal hal karne mein taqreeban 30 saal (1920s se 1950s) lage.

book_ref.quote: scientists tried to determine whether genes are made of DNA, or protein or both

blocks.prompt:
32 In 1928, Fredrick Griffith performed his experiments on:
(1928 mein Fredrick Griffith ne apne tajarbe kis par kiye?)

options.text: ¹⁵N medium mein ugaye gaye bacteria

blocks.explanation: 1928 mein British biologist Fredrick Griffith ne bimari paida karne wale bacterium Streptococcus pneumoniae par kaam kiya.

book_ref.quote: worked on a pathogenic bacterium Streptococcus pneumoniae

blocks.prompt:
33 The S-type strain of Streptococcus pneumoniae:
(Streptococcus pneumoniae ka S-type strain kaisa hota hai?)

options.text: polysaccharide coat nahin rakhta aur rough colony banata hai
protein coat rakhta hai aur rough colony banata hai
polysaccharide coat rakhta hai aur smooth colony banata hai
zinda inject karne par chuhon ko nuqsan nahin deta

blocks.explanation: S-type strain par polysaccharide coat hota hai aur is ki colony smooth (hamwar) hoti hai; R-type par coat nahin hota aur colony rough hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: strain had a polysaccharide coat and its colony appears

blocks.prompt:
34 When Griffith injected heat-killed S-type bacteria alone into mice, the mice:
(Jab Griffith ne sirf garmi se maare gaye S-type bacteria chuhon mein inject kiye to chuhe:)

options.text: khoon mein zinda S-type bacteria dikhaye

blocks.explanation: Sirf garmi se maare gaye S-type bacteria se chuhe sehatmand rahe.

book_ref.quote: Then, he injected heat-killed S-type bacteria into mice, they remained healthy

blocks.prompt:
35 Griffith injected a mixture of heat-killed S-type and live R-type bacteria into mice. The result was:
(Griffith ne garmi se maare S-type aur zinda R-type bacteria ka mixture chuhon mein inject kiya. Natija kya tha?)

options.text: chuhe mar gaye aur sirf R-type bacteria mile
chuhon mein S-type ke khilaf immunity ban gayi
chuhe mar gaye aur un ke khoon mein zinda S-type bacteria mile

blocks.explanation: Griffith ki tawaqqo ke khilaf chuhon ko pneumonia hua aur woh mar gaye, aur un ke khoon mein bohat se zinda S-type bacteria mile.

book_ref.quote: he injected a mixture of heat-killed S-type (virulent, but killed) and alive R-type

blocks.prompt:
36 The transfer of genetic material from one organism to another to change the genetic makeup of the recipient is called:
(Aik organism se doosre mein genetic material ki muntaqili, jis se lene wale ki genetic banawat badal jaye, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Griffith ne is amal ko transformation kaha: R-type ne maare gaye S-type se maloomat le kar virulent S-type ban gaya.

book_ref.quote: He called this process as transformation

blocks.prompt:
37 Which question did Griffith's experiment leave unanswered?
(Griffith ke tajarbe ne kaun sa sawal be-jawab chhora?)

options.text: kya garmi S-type ko maar deti hai
maare S-type se zinda R-type mein jane wale material ki kimiyai noiyat
kya R-type rough colony banata hai

blocks.explanation: Griffith maloom na kar saka ke maare gaye S-type se zinda R-type mein jane wala material kimiyai tor par kya tha (DNA, protein ya dono).

book_ref.quote: Griffith could not find the chemical nature (DNA or protein or both)

blocks.prompt:
38 Avery, MacLeod and McCarty (1944) removed all DNA from dead S-type bacteria, mixed them with live R-type and injected mice. The mice:
(Avery, MacLeod aur McCarty (1944) ne maare S-type se saari DNA nikal kar zinda R-type ke saath mila kar chuhon mein inject kiya. Chuhe:)

options.text: mar gaye kyun ke proteins ne R-type badal diya
sehatmand rahe kyun ke transformation nahin hui
mar gaye aur zinda S-type mile
khoon mein rough colonies ban gayin

blocks.explanation: DNA ke baghair transformation nahin hui aur chuhe sehatmand rahe; is se natija nikla ke DNA hi transforming principle ki bunyadi ikai hai.

book_ref.quote: They mixed S-type (without DNA) with alive R-type and injected into mice

blocks.prompt:
39 Alfred Hershey and Martha Chase performed their experiments with bacteriophages in:
(Alfred Hershey aur Martha Chase ne bacteriophages par apne tajarbe kab kiye?)
blocks.explanation: 1952 mein American biologists Alfred Hershey aur Martha Chase ne bacteriophages ke zariye tasdeeq ki ke DNA genetic material hai.

book_ref.quote: In 1952, two American biologists, Alfred Hershey and Martha Chase

blocks.prompt:
40 In the Hershey-Chase experiment, the radioactive isotopes served as:
(Hershey-Chase tajarbe mein radioactive isotopes ka kya kirdar tha?)

options.text: DNA aur protein ko alag alag nishaan dene wale tracers

blocks.explanation: Unhon ne bacteriophage ki DNA aur protein ko mukhtalif radioactive isotopes se nishaan zada kiya; yeh isotopes tracers (pata dene wale) the.

book_ref.quote: The isotopes would serve as Tracers

blocks.prompt:
41 Bacteriophages grown on a medium containing ³⁵S had the radioactive label in their:
(³⁵S wale medium par ugaye gaye bacteriophages mein radioactive nishaan kahan tha?)
blocks.explanation: ³⁵S naye bacteriophages ke protein coat ke amino acids mein shamil hua.

book_ref.quote: The isotope was incorporated into the amino acids of the protein coats

blocks.prompt:
42 In the Hershey-Chase experiment, ³²P was incorporated into the:
(Hershey-Chase tajarbe mein ³²P kahan shamil hua?)

options.text: virus ki DNA ke phosphate groups

blocks.explanation: ³²P naye viruses ki DNA ke phosphate groups mein shamil hua.

book_ref.quote: The isotope was incorporated into the phosphate groups of the DNA of new viruses

blocks.prompt:
43 In setup 1 (bacteriophages with ³⁵S labelled protein), radioactivity was found:
(Setup 1 (³⁵S wali protein ke bacteriophages) mein radioactivity kahan mili?)

options.text: bacteria ke cells mein, medium mein nahin
cells aur medium dono mein barabar
na cells mein na medium mein
medium mein, bacteria ke cells mein nahin

blocks.explanation: ³⁵S wali protein ke saath radioactivity medium mein rahi, bacteria ke andar nahin: protein coat bahar hi raha.

book_ref.quote: they found radioactivity in the medium and not in the bacterial cells

blocks.prompt:
44 Hershey and Chase separated the infected bacterial cells from the medium by:
(Hershey aur Chase ne infected bacterial cells ko medium se kaise alag kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch der baad dono setups ke infected cells aur medium ko centrifugation se alag kiya gaya.

book_ref.quote: were separated by using centrifugation technique

blocks.prompt:
45 DNA in chromatids replicates during the:
(Chromatids ki DNA kis waqt replicate hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNA replication cell ke taqseem hone se pehle, interphase ke S-phase mein hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It happens before a cell divides i.e., during the S-phase of interphase

blocks.text: 19.3.1 Models Proposed for the Mechanism of DNA Replication

blocks.prompt:
46 The model of DNA replication in which one daughter DNA has both parental strands and the other has both new strands is:
(DNA replication ka woh model jis mein aik daughter DNA mein dono purani strands aur doosri mein dono nayi strands hon:)
blocks.explanation: Conservative model mein parent double helix qaim rehta hai; aik daughter DNA mein dono purani aur doosri mein dono nayi strands hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: 1 daughter DNA contains both strands of parent DNA, and

blocks.prompt:
47 According to the dispersive model, after replication:
(Dispersive model ke mutabiq replication ke baad kya hota hai?)

options.text: har daughter DNA mein aik purani aur aik nayi strand
dono daughter DNAs ki strands purane aur naye nucleotides ka mixture hoti hain

blocks.explanation: Dispersive model mein parent DNA nucleotides mein toot kar naye nucleotides se milti hai, is liye har strand purane aur naye nucleotides ka mixture hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Both daughter DNAs contain strands which are mixtures of old and new nucleotides

blocks.prompt:
48 Meselson and Stahl evaluated the three models of DNA replication in:
(Meselson aur Stahl ne DNA replication ke teen models ko kab parkha?)
blocks.explanation: 1958 mein Mathew Meselson aur Franklin Stahl ne teenon models parkhe aur semi-conservative model sabit kiya.

book_ref.quote: In 1958, two American biologists, Mathew Meselson and Franklin Stahl

blocks.prompt:
49 To make the bacterial DNA denser, Meselson and Stahl grew bacteria in a medium containing:
(Bacteria ki DNA ko zyada ghana (dense) banane ke liye Meselson aur Stahl ne bacteria kis medium mein ugaye?)
blocks.explanation: Unhon ne bacteria ko bhari isotope ¹⁵N wale medium mein ugaya, jo aam ¹⁴N ki jagah DNA ki nitrogen bases mein shamil hua.

book_ref.quote: They grew bacteria in a medium containing heavy isotope of nitrogen

blocks.prompt:
50 For ultracentrifugation, Meselson and Stahl dissolved the collected DNA in an aqueous solution of:
(Ultracentrifugation ke liye Meselson aur Stahl ne DNA ko kis ke paani wale mehlool mein hal kiya?)
blocks.explanation: DNA ko cesium chloride ke paani wale mehlool mein hal kiya gaya; ultracentrifugation se cesium ki density ka gradient bana.

book_ref.quote: They dissolved the collected DNA in aqueous solution of cesium chloride

blocks.prompt:
51 During ultracentrifugation in the cesium gradient, each DNA settled:
(Cesium gradient mein ultracentrifugation ke dauran har DNA kahan thehri?)

options.text: hamesha tube ki bilkul tah mein
jahan us ki density wahan ke cesium ki density ke bilkul barabar thi
lambai ke mutabiq, density ke mutabiq nahin

blocks.explanation: Har DNA wahan thehri jahan us ki density cesium ki density ke barabar thi; bhari ¹⁵N DNA halki ¹⁴N DNA se zyada neeche gayi.

book_ref.quote: Each DNA strand settled at the position where its density was exactly matching

blocks.prompt:
52 The sample collected at 20 minutes, after the first replication in ¹⁴N medium, formed:
(¹⁴N medium mein pehli replication ke baad 20 minute par liya gaya sample kya bana?)
blocks.explanation: 20 minute par (pehli replication ke baad) DNA ne darmiyani density ki aik hi tah banayi, ¹⁴N-DNA aur ¹⁵N-DNA ke darmiyan.

book_ref.quote: Second sample was collected at 20 minutes

blocks.prompt:
53 The third sample, collected after 40 minutes (second replication), showed:
(40 minute baad (doosri replication) liye gaye teesre sample mein kya dikha?)

options.text: do tahein: aik darmiyani aur aik halki
do tahein: aik bhari aur aik halki

blocks.explanation: Doosri replication ke baad DNA ne do tahein banayin: aik darmiyani aur aik halki (¹⁴N-DNA ke barabar).

book_ref.quote: Third sample was collected after 40 minutes

blocks.prompt:
54 DNA collected after the first replication was intermediate in density because each daughter DNA:
(Pehli replication ke baad DNA darmiyani density ki thi kyun ke har daughter DNA:)

options.text: strands mein ¹⁴N aur ¹⁵N nucleotides mile jule the
aik ¹⁴N strand aur aik ¹⁵N strand ka hybrid thi

blocks.explanation: Har daughter DNA hybrid thi: aik strand ¹⁴N ki aur aik ¹⁵N ki, jaisa semi-conservative model kehta hai.

book_ref.quote: DNA collected after first replication was intermediate in density

blocks.prompt:
55 In a pulse-chase experiment, the "pulse" stage is the stage in which:
(Pulse-chase tajarbe mein "pulse" stage kya hai?)

options.text: nishaan wali DNA ko waqt ke saath dekha jata hai
organism ko thori der radio-isotope ke saamne rakha jata hai
DNA ko cesium chloride mein centrifuge kiya jata hai

blocks.explanation: Pulse stage mein organism ko thori der radio-isotope diya jata hai aur woh use DNA mein shamil karta hai; chase stage mein nishaan wali DNA ko waqt ke saath dekha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: the organism is exposed to the radio-isotope for a brief time

blocks.prompt:
56 The number of replication origin sites on DNA is:
(DNA par replication origin sites kitni hoti hain?)

options.text: prokaryotes mein aik aur eukaryotes mein bohat si
prokaryotes mein bohat si aur eukaryotes mein aik
prokaryotes mein do aur eukaryotes mein chaar

blocks.explanation: Prokaryotes mein sirf aik replication origin site hoti hai, jab ke eukaryotes mein DNA ki lambai par bohat si.

book_ref.quote: In prokaryotes, there is only one replication origin site

blocks.prompt:
57 The protein that binds to the replication origin site and initiates replication is:
(Woh protein jo replication origin site se jur kar replication shuru karti hai:)
blocks.explanation: Initiator protein replication origin site se jurti hai aur amal shuru karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Initiator protein binds to the replication origin site and initiates the process

blocks.prompt:
58 At the origin site, helicases unwind DNA by breaking the:
(Origin site par helicases DNA ko kya tor kar kholte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kholne wale enzymes, helicases, dono strands ke base-pairs ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds torte hain.

book_ref.quote: enzymes called helicases break the hydrogen bonds

blocks.prompt:
59 The two Y-shaped replication forks formed at an origin are collectively called a:
(Origin par bane do Y shakal ke replication forks ko mil kar kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alag hui strands do Y shakal ke replication forks banati hain, jinhein mil kar replication bubble kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: make two Y-shaped structures called replication forks

blocks.prompt:
60 The role of single-strand binding proteins in replication is to:
(Replication mein single-strand binding proteins ka kaam kya hai?)

options.text: bases ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds torna
alag strands ko dobara jurne aur lipatne se rokna

blocks.explanation: Single-strand binding proteins akeli strands se jur kar unhein dobara jurne aur lipatne se rokti hain.

book_ref.quote: Single-strand binding proteins bind to single strands

blocks.prompt:
61 A primer used in DNA replication is a short fragment of:
(DNA replication mein istemal hone wala primer kis ka chhota tukra hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primase origin par har template strand ke saamne 5-10 RNA nucleotides ka chhota tukra, yani primer, lagata hai.

book_ref.quote: This short fragment of 5-10 RNA nucleotides is called primer

blocks.prompt:
62 Why is the primer made of RNA rather than DNA?
(Primer DNA ke bajaye RNA ka kyun hota hai?)

options.text: RNA, DNA se zyada mazboot jorti hai
DNA polymerase bilkul DNA nahin bana sakta
RNA nayi strand ka code rakhti hai
RNA ghalti wale shuru ke hisse ko aarzi nishaan deti hai taa ke baad mein aasani se nikal sake

blocks.explanation: Khuli template par chain shuru karne mein bohat ghaltiyan hoti hain; RNA primer is hisse ko aarzi (temporary) nishaan deta hai taa ke baad mein aasani se nikal sake.

book_ref.quote: Starting chains on exposed templates introduces many errors

blocks.prompt:
63 In prokaryotes, the main enzyme that adds new nucleotides along the template strands is:
(Prokaryotes mein template strands par naye nucleotides jorne wala bunyadi enzyme kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prokaryotes mein DNA polymerase I, II aur III hain, magar replication ka bunyadi enzyme DNA polymerase III hai.

book_ref.quote: But, DNA polymerase III is the main enzyme

blocks.prompt:
64 DNA polymerase II in prokaryotes is involved in:
(Prokaryotes mein DNA polymerase II kis kaam mein shamil hai?)

options.text: replication ke aakhir mein primers badalna
cell ki zindagi mein DNA ke nuqsan ki marammat

blocks.explanation: Polymerase II cell ki zindagi mein DNA ke nuqsan ki marammat karta hai; polymerase I primers badalta hai; polymerase III asal banane wala hai.

book_ref.quote: Polymerase II is involved in the repairing process of DNA damages

blocks.prompt:
65 The energy used to build a new DNA strand comes from:
(Nayi DNA strand banane ke liye energy kahan se aati hai?)

options.text: har deoxyribonucleoside triphosphate ke do phosphates tootne se
helicase ke hydrogen bonds torne se

blocks.explanation: Kham maal dATP, dCTP, dGTP aur dTTP hain; DNA polymerase III jab aik ko jorta hai to do phosphates torta hai, jis se banane ke liye energy milti hai.

book_ref.quote: As DNA Polymerase III attaches a nucleotide to the strand, it breaks off two phosphates

blocks.prompt:
66 DNA polymerase III can add a new nucleotide only to the:
(DNA polymerase III naya nucleotide sirf kahan jor sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNA polymerase III naya nucleotide sirf maujooda nucleotide ke 3′ sire par jorta hai, is liye 5′ se 3′ simt mein banata hai.

book_ref.quote: DNA Polymerase III can only add a new nucleotide to the 3

blocks.prompt:
67 Which statement about primers in replication is correct?
(Replication mein primers ke bare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Leading strand ko har chand nucleotides baad naya primer chahiye
Kisi strand ko primer nahin chahiye
Lagging strand sirf aik primer se barhti hai
Lagging strand ko har Okazaki fragment ke liye naya primer chahiye

blocks.explanation: Leading strand aik hi primer se barh sakti hai, jab ke lagging strand ko har Okazaki fragment ke liye naya primer chahiye.

book_ref.quote: whereas the lagging strand needs a new primer for each Okazaki fragment

blocks.prompt:
68 The region of DNA between the origin site and the termination site is called:
(Origin site aur termination site ke darmiyan DNA ka hissa kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Origin site aur termination site ke darmiyan ka hissa replication unit ya replicon kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: is termed as a replication unit or replicon

blocks.prompt:
69 During termination of replication, DNA polymerase I:
(Replication ke khatme par DNA polymerase I kya karta hai?)

options.text: dono purani strands ko jorta hai
RNA primers nikal kar khali jagah DNA nucleotides se bharta hai

blocks.explanation: DNA polymerase I RNA primer nikal kar khali jagah DNA nucleotides se bharta hai, aur Okazaki fragments ke darmiyan khali jagah bhi.

book_ref.quote: DNA polymerase I removes the RNA primer and fills in the gap

blocks.prompt:
70 The number of DNA polymerases in eukaryotes is at least:
(Eukaryotes mein DNA polymerases kam az kam kitne hain?)
blocks.explanation: Prokaryotes DNA polymerase I, II aur III istemal karte hain; eukaryotes mein kam az kam 14 polymerases hain (jaise alpha, delta, epsilon).

book_ref.quote: In eukaryotes, there are at least 14 polymerases

blocks.prompt:
71 The length of Okazaki fragments in eukaryotes is about:
(Eukaryotes mein Okazaki fragments ki lambai taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotes mein Okazaki fragments chhote (100-200 nucleotides) hain; prokaryotes mein lambe (1000-2000 nucleotides).

book_ref.quote: In eukaryotes, the Okazaki fragments are short

blocks.prompt:
72 The technique in which DNA replication is used to make billions of copies of a specific DNA is:
(Woh technique jis mein DNA replication se kisi khaas DNA ki arbon copies banai jati hain:)
blocks.explanation: PCR mein scientists replication kar ke kisi khaas DNA ki arbon copies banate hain.

book_ref.quote: scientists conduct replication process to make billions of copies of a specific DNA

blocks.prompt:
73 "Stability" of DNA means its ability to:
(DNA ki "stability" ka matlab us ki kis salahiyat se hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stability ka matlab hai DNA ka durusti se copy hona; DNA polymerase III ki proofreading (ghalti durust karne) ki salahiyat sequence ko barqarar rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: means the ability of DNA to be copied with accuracy

blocks.prompt:
74 Variability of DNA is important because it:
(DNA ki variability kyun ahem hai?)

options.text: organism ke khaas traits ko na badalne deti hai
evolution ka kham maal hai aur populations ko dhalne deti hai

blocks.explanation: Variability (mutation) naye traits ka bunyadi zariya hai; is se populations badalte mahol mein dhal sakti hain aur yeh evolution ka kham maal hai.

book_ref.quote: Variability is the primary source of new traits

blocks.prompt:
75 According to the central dogma, the flow of genetic information is:
(Central dogma ke mutabiq genetic maloomat ka bahao kaisa hai?)

options.text: DNA aur protein ke darmiyan dono taraf
aik taraf: DNA se RNA se protein, protein se kabhi wapis nahin

blocks.explanation: Central dogma (Francis Crick) DNA → RNA → Protein hai; bahao aik taraf hai aur protein mein jane ke baad maloomat wapis nahin jati.

book_ref.quote: It means that the flow of genetic information is one-way

blocks.prompt:
76 Crick reasoned that if a codon were only 2 nucleotides long, the number of possible codons would be:
(Crick ne socha ke agar codon sirf 2 nucleotides ka ho to mumkina codons kitne honge?)
blocks.explanation: Akele nucleotides sirf 4 amino acids ka code dete; 2 nucleotides se 16 (4 × 4) codons bante, jo 20 amino acids se kam hain.

book_ref.quote: Even a sequence of 2 nucleotides would make 16

blocks.prompt:
77 The four nucleotides arranged as triplets give a total of:
(Chaar nucleotides triplets ki shakal mein kul kitne combinations dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar nucleotides 64 (4 × 4 × 4) triplets banate hain, jo 20 amino acids ke liye kaafi se zyada hain.

book_ref.quote: The 4 nucleotides can be arranged in 64

blocks.prompt:
78 The DNA codon TAC is transcribed into the mRNA codon:
(DNA ka codon TAC mRNA par kis codon mein transcribe hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNA ke codons mRNA par complementary codons bante hain, is liye DNA ka TAC mRNA par AUG hai.

book_ref.quote: So, the TAC codon on DNA would mean AUG codon on mRNA

blocks.prompt:
79 Nirenberg added a poly-U mRNA to the cytoplasm of bacteria and obtained a polypeptide of phenylalanine. He concluded that:
(Nirenberg ne poly-U mRNA bacteria ke cytoplasm mein dala aur phenylalanine ki polypeptide bani. Unhon ne kya natija nikala?)
blocks.explanation: Poly-U mRNA se bohat se phenylalanine wali polypeptide bani, is liye codon UUU phenylalanine ka hai.

book_ref.quote: He concluded that the codon UUU specifies phenylalanine

blocks.prompt:
80 Har Gobind Khorana, who studied at Government College, Lahore, determined the amino acids specified by:
(Har Gobind Khorana (jinhon ne Government College, Lahore mein taleem hasil ki) ne kitne codons ke amino acids maloom kiye?)
blocks.explanation: Nirenberg aur Leder ne 47 codons ke amino acids maloom kiye; Khorana ne baqi 17 codons ke.

book_ref.quote: determined the amino acids specified by the remaining 17 triplet codons

blocks.prompt:
81 Which set contains only stop (nonsense) codons?
(Kis set mein sirf stop (nonsense) codons hain?)
blocks.explanation: 64 codons mein se UGA, UAG aur UAA stop codons hain; AUG start codon hai.

book_ref.quote: three codons (UGA, UAG, and UAA) are stop codons

blocks.prompt:
82 In the 1968 Nobel Prize, Robert Holley was honoured for:
(1968 ke Nobel Prize mein Robert Holley ko kis kaam par inaam mila?)

options.text: transfer-RNA ki kimiyai banawat daryaft karna

blocks.explanation: 1968 ka Nobel Prize Nirenberg (genetic code), Khorana (nucleic acids ki tayyari) aur Robert Holley (tRNA ki kimiyai banawat) ko mila.

book_ref.quote: Robert Holley (discovering the chemical structure of transfer-RNA)

blocks.prompt:
83 Genes can be transferred among organisms because the genetic code is:
(Genes organisms ke darmiyan muntaqil ho sakte hain kyun ke genetic code:)
blocks.explanation: Genetic code taqreeban tamam organisms mein aik jaisa hai (maslan AGA bacteria aur insanon mein arginine hai), is liye genes muntaqil ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Due to this characteristic, genes can be transferred among organisms.

blocks.prompt:
84 An exception to the universality of the genetic code is found in:
(Genetic code ki universality ki aik istisna (exception) kahan milti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mitochondria ki DNA ka genetic code chromosomes ki DNA se thora mukhtalif hai, jo mitochondria ki alag evolutionary tareekh dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: genetic code in the DNA of mitochondria is slightly different

blocks.prompt:
85 Which is a correct example of the degeneracy of the genetic code?
(Genetic code ki degeneracy ki sahi misaal kaun si hai?)

options.text: AUG, GUG, UUG aur CUG sab methionine ka code dete hain
GUU, GUC, GUA aur GUG sab valine ka code dete hain
UGA, UAG aur UAA sab glycine ka code dete hain
UUU chaar amino acids ka code deta hai

blocks.explanation: Degeneracy ka matlab hai kayi codons aik hi amino acid ka code den: GUU, GUC, GUA aur GUG sab valine ke hain (book correction: methionine ka sirf AUG hai).

book_ref.quote: four different codons, GUU, GUC, GUA and GUG, code for the same amino acid, valine

blocks.prompt:
86 Because the genetic code is non-overlapping, the sequence AUGAGCGCA is read as:
(Genetic code non-overlapping hai, is liye sequence AUGAGCGCA kaise parhi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har triplet saath wale codons se alag parha jata hai, is liye AUGAGCGCA sirf AUG/AGC/GCA parhi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: These will only be read as AUG/AGC/GCA

blocks.prompt:
87 "A codon does not have punctuations" means that:
("Codon mein waqfe (punctuation) nahin" ka matlab kya hai?)

options.text: codon ke teen nucleotides baghair waqfe musalsal parhe jate hain
codons saath walon se overlap karte hain
har amino acid ka sirf aik codon hai

blocks.explanation: Codon musalsal parha jata hai, us ke teen nucleotides ke darmiyan koi waqfa (gap) nahin hota.

book_ref.quote: It means that it is without punctuation (gaps)

blocks.prompt:
88 The DNA strand that is not transcribed and has the same sequence as the mRNA (with T in place of U) is the:
(DNA ki woh strand jo transcribe nahin hoti aur jis ki sequence mRNA jaisi hai (U ki jagah T), kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf template strand transcribe hoti hai; doosri coding strand hai jis ki sequence mRNA jaisi hai, bas U ki jagah T.

book_ref.quote: The other strand of DNA that is not transcribed is called the coding strand

blocks.prompt:
89 The template strand of DNA is also known as the:
(DNA ki template strand ko aur kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Template strand antisense (–) strand hai aur coding strand sense (+) strand.

book_ref.quote: The template strand of DNA is also known as the antisense

blocks.prompt:
90 Unlike DNA replication, the initiation of transcription:
(DNA replication ke baraks transcription ka aaghaz:)
blocks.explanation: Transcription mein primer ki zaroorat nahin; RNA polymerase template DNA ki promoter sequence se jurta hai.

book_ref.quote: In this process, no primer is needed

blocks.prompt:
91 In prokaryotes, the promoter located 10 nucleotides before the start point of a gene (–10 sequence) is:
(Prokaryotes mein gene ke start point se 10 nucleotides pehle wala promoter (–10 sequence) kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prokaryotes mein TTGACA –35 sequence aur TATAAT –10 sequence hai; TATAAA (TATA box) aur GGCCAATCT (CAAT box) eukaryotic hain.

book_ref.quote: another promoter TATAAT is 10 nucleotides before the start point of gene

blocks.prompt:
92 In eukaryotes, the CAAT box (GGCCAATCT) lies before the start point of a gene by:
(Eukaryotes mein CAAT box (GGCCAATCT) gene ke start point se kitna pehle hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotes mein TATA box (TATAAA) –25 par aur CAAT box (GGCCAATCT) –70 par hai.

book_ref.quote: a promoter GGCCAATCT (called CAAT box) is 70 nucleotides before

blocks.prompt:
93 In eukaryotes, mRNA is synthesized by:
(Eukaryotes mein mRNA kaun banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotes mein teen RNA polymerases hain: I nucleolus mein rRNA, II mRNA aur III tRNA banata hai; prokaryotes mein sirf aik hai.

book_ref.quote: RNA polymerase II synthesizes mRNA

blocks.prompt:
94 The subunit of RNA polymerase that binds with the template DNA is the:
(RNA polymerase ki kaun si subunit template DNA se jurti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do α subunits regulatory proteins se, β′ template DNA se, β RNA nucleotides se jurti hai aur σ promoter pehchanti hai.

book_ref.quote: a β′ subunit binds with template DNA

blocks.prompt:
95 After the σ subunit is removed, the remaining four subunits of RNA polymerase are called the:
(σ subunit hatne ke baad RNA polymerase ki baqi chaar subunits ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Promoter se jurne par σ subunit hat jati hai; baqi chaar subunits (core enzyme) DNA kholti hain aur transcription bubble banati hain.

book_ref.quote: The other four subunits (core enzyme) catalyse the process

blocks.prompt:
96 The raw material attached by RNA polymerase during elongation of transcription is:
(Transcription ki elongation mein RNA polymerase kaun sa kham maal jorta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleotides ribonucleoside triphosphates (rNTP) ki shakal mein hote hain; jurte waqt in ke do phosphates energy ke saath alag hote hain.

book_ref.quote: the nucleotides available for attachment are in the form of ribonucleoside triphosphates

blocks.prompt:
97 The new mRNA chain made in the transcription bubble usually starts with:
(Transcription bubble mein banne wali mRNA chain aam tor par kis se shuru hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: RNA polymerase chain 5′ se 3′ simt mein banata hai; yeh aam tor par A ya G ribonucleotide se shuru hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It usually starts with A or G ribonucleotide

blocks.prompt:
98 During elongation of transcription, the first 12 bases of the new mRNA make a temporary helix with template DNA. This:
(Transcription ki elongation mein nayi mRNA ke pehle 12 bases template DNA ke saath aarzi helix banate hain. Is se:)

options.text: mRNA ka 3′ sira agle ribonucleotide ke liye mustahkam rehta hai

blocks.explanation: Aarzi RNA-DNA helix mRNA ke 3′ sire ko catalytic site par mustahkam rakhta hai taa ke agla ribonucleotide jur sake.

book_ref.quote: The first 12 bases of new mRNA strand make a temporary helix

blocks.prompt:
99 In termination of transcription, the GC hairpin formed in the mRNA:
(Transcription ke khatme par mRNA mein bana GC hairpin kya karta hai?)

options.text: RNA polymerase ko rok deta hai

blocks.explanation: GC hairpin RNA polymerase ko rok deta hai; chaar U aur A ki kamzor jorai hybrid ko thaam nahin sakti, RNA alag ho jati hai aur transcription ruk jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The GC hairpin causes the RNA polymerase to pause

blocks.prompt:
100 The 5′ cap added to eukaryotic mRNA is a:
(Eukaryotic mRNA par lagne wala 5′ cap kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aakhri A ya G ke 5′ sire par methylated GTP lagaya jata hai; yeh 5′ cap mRNA ko nucleases aur phosphatases se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: end of A or G a methylated GTP is attached

blocks.prompt:
101 The 3′ poly-A tail added to eukaryotic mRNA consists of about:
(Eukaryotic mRNA ki 3′ poly-A tail taqreeban kitne nucleotides ki hai?)
blocks.explanation: mRNA ke 3′ sire par taqreeban 250 A nucleotides ki chain (poly-A tail) lagai jati hai; yeh nucleases se bachati hai.

book_ref.quote: a small chain of about 250 A nucleotides is added

blocks.prompt:
102 How many kinds of aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase are there?
(Aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase ki kitni qismein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase ki 20 qismein hain; har aik khaas amino acid aur us ke anticodon wale tRNA se jurti hai.

book_ref.quote: There are 20 kinds of this enzyme

blocks.prompt:
103 The initiation complex of translation consists of:
(Translation ka initiation complex kin cheezon par mushtamil hai?)

options.text: sirf chhoti ribosomal subunit aur mRNA
dono ribosomal subunits, pehla aa-tRNA, mRNA aur enzyme

blocks.explanation: Initiation complex dono ribosomal subunits, pehle aa-tRNA, mRNA aur enzyme par mushtamil hai.

book_ref.quote: The initiation complex formed in this way consists of both ribosomal subunits

blocks.prompt:
104 The E site of a ribosome is the site where:
(Ribosome ki E site woh jagah hai jahan:)

options.text: khali tRNAs ribosome se nikalte hain

blocks.explanation: P site par peptide bonds bante hain; A site par agla aa-tRNA jurta hai; E site se khali tRNAs ribosome se nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: where empty tRNAs will exit the ribosome

blocks.prompt:
105 With respect to mRNA, the three ribosomal sites are oriented from 5′ to 3′ as:
(mRNA ke lihaz se ribosome ki teen sites 5′ se 3′ kis tarteeb mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sites 5′ se 3′ E-P-A tarteeb mein hain kyun ke ribosome mRNA ke 3′ sire ki taraf chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: With respect to mRNA, the three sites are oriented in 5

blocks.prompt:
106 In elongation, the next aa-tRNA with a matching anticodon binds to the A site with the help of:
(Elongation mein milte anticodon wala agla aa-tRNA A site se kis ki madad se jurta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agla aa-tRNA elongation factor ki madad se A site se jurta hai.

book_ref.quote: binds to A site with the help of an enzyme, the elongation factor

blocks.prompt:
107 The enzyme that joins the amino acid on the P site tRNA to the amino acid at the A site by a peptide bond is:
(Woh enzyme jo P site ke tRNA wale amino acid ko A site ke amino acid se peptide bond se jorta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Peptidyl transferase P site ke pehle aa-tRNA se methionine utar kar use A site ke amino acid se peptide bond se jorta hai.

book_ref.quote: Another enzyme peptidyl transferase removes methionine from first aa-tRNA

blocks.prompt:
108 The movement of the ribosome three nucleotides along the mRNA in the 5′ to 3′ direction is called:
(Ribosome ka mRNA par 5′ se 3′ simt mein teen nucleotides aage barhna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ribosome mRNA par teen nucleotides aage barhta hai (translocation); chain wala tRNA A se P site par aur khali tRNA E site par jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This movement is called translocation

blocks.prompt:
109 When a stop codon reaches the A site, it is recognized by:
(Jab stop codon A site par aata hai to use kaun pehchanta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stop codon ke liye koi aa-tRNA nahin aata; release factor naam ki protein use pehchan kar P site ke tRNA se polypeptide alag kar deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Stop codon at A site is recognized by a protein called release factor

blocks.text: 19.6.1 Difference between Translation in Prokaryotes and Eukaryotes

blocks.prompt:
110 Which feature is true of translation in eukaryotes but not in prokaryotes?
(Kaun si baat eukaryotes ki translation mein hai magar prokaryotes mein nahin?)

options.text: Pehla amino acid N-formyl methionine hai
Translation cytoplasm aur rough endoplasmic reticulum dono par, 80S ribosomes par hoti hai
mRNA baghair tabdeeli foran translate hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Eukaryotes mein translation cytoplasm aur rough ER par bare 80S ribosomes par hoti hai; prokaryotes mein 70S ribosomes, N-formyl methionine aur mRNA mein koi tabdeeli nahin.

book_ref.quote: Translation occurs in cytoplasm as well as in rough endoplasmic reticulum.

blocks.prompt:
111 Turning genes ON and OFF and the timing of their expression are controlled by:
(Genes ko ON aur OFF karna aur un ke izhar ka waqt kaun control karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Genes ko ON/OFF karna aur un ke izhar ka waqt regulator proteins control karti hain; isi ko regulation of gene expression kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: controlled by regulator proteins and the process is called regulation of gene expression

blocks.prompt:
112 In multicellular organisms, gene regulation is the basis of:
(Multicellular organisms mein gene regulation kis cheez ki bunyad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gene regulation cellular differentiation aur morphogenesis ki bunyad hai: cells ka genome aik hai magar mukhtalif genes izhar karte hain.

book_ref.quote: gene regulation is the basis for cellular differentiation and morphogenesis

blocks.prompt:
113 In negative gene regulation, repressor proteins bind to:
(Negative gene regulation mein repressor proteins kis se jurti hain?)

options.text: promoter ke qareeb operators se, RNA polymerase ko rok kar

blocks.explanation: Repressors promoter ke qareeb operators se jur kar RNA polymerase ko rokte hain aur transcription band ya kam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: called repressors bind to some pieces of DNA, called operators

blocks.prompt:
114 At the post-translational level, gene expression is regulated by controlling:
(Post-translational level par gene expression kis cheez ko control kar ke regulate hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transcription level: transcription ki raftar; post-transcriptional: mRNA ki tabdeeli; translation: translation ki raftar; post-translational: protein ki tabdeeli (folding, stability).

book_ref.quote: At post-translational, the modification of protein

blocks.prompt:
115 Regulation during splicing, in which introns or exons are removed in different ways, results in:
(Splicing ke dauran regulation, jis mein introns ya exons mukhtalif tareeqon se nikale jate hain, ka natija kya hai?)

options.text: gene ka koi protein na banana
aik gene se aik se zyada polypeptides

blocks.explanation: Khaas cells mein regulatory proteins introns ya exons mukhtalif tareeqon se nikalti hain, mukhtalif lambai ki mRNAs banti hain aur aik gene se aik se zyada polypeptides.

book_ref.quote: It results in the production of more than one polypeptide from a single gene

blocks.prompt:
116 The genes for alcohol dehydrogenase are present in both liver cells and brain neurons, but they are:
(Alcohol dehydrogenase ke genes liver cells aur dimagh ke neurons dono mein hain, magar:)

options.text: neurons mein ON aur liver cells mein OFF
liver cells mein ON aur neurons mein OFF hain
liver cells mein maujood hi nahin

blocks.explanation: Liver cells alcohol dehydrogenase ke genes izhar karte hain jo alcohol ko be-zarar molecules mein torta hai; neurons in genes ko OFF rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Liver cells express specific genes which make the enzyme alcohol dehydrogenase

blocks.prompt:
117 A change in the content of the genetic message is called:
(Genetic paigham ke mawad mein tabdeeli ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Genetic paigham mein tabdeeli mutation hai; yeh chhoti (aik ya chand nucleotides) ya bari (bara hissa ya poora chromosome) ho sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: A change in the content of genetic message is called mutation

blocks.prompt:
118 The organism or cell in which a mutation occurs is called a:
(Jis organism ya cell mein mutation ho, use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mutation paida karne wale agents mutagens hain; jis organism ya cell mein mutation ho woh mutant hai.

book_ref.quote: the organism or cell in which mutation occurs is called mutant

blocks.prompt:
119 Which of the following can cause induced mutations?
(In mein se kaun si cheez induced mutations paida kar sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Induced mutations bairooni asbaab se hoti hain: mutagens, radiation, mahol ke chemicals (pesticides, sanati aloodgi) ya ilaj jaise chemotherapy.

book_ref.quote: or from medical treatments such as chemotherapy

blocks.prompt:
120 The ultimate sources of all genetic variation are:
(Tamam genetic variation ke aakhri zariye kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mutation aur recombination naye DNA sequences (alleles) aur alleles ke combinations banate hain; natural selection in variations par amal karta hai.

book_ref.quote: These processes create new DNA sequence (allele) and combination of alleles

blocks.prompt:
121 Mutations involving a change in only one or a few nucleotides are called:
(Sirf aik ya chand nucleotides ki tabdeeli wali mutations ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Point mutations mein sirf aik ya chand nucleotides badalte hain; yeh sab se aam gene mutations hain.

book_ref.quote: The mutations involving the change in only one or a few nucleotides

blocks.prompt:
122 During replication, A is replaced by G at one position. This point mutation is a/an:
(Replication ke dauran aik jagah A ki jagah G aa gaya. Yeh kaun si point mutation hai?)
blocks.explanation: Substitution mein aik nucleotide doosre se badal jata hai, maslan A ki jagah G ya C ki jagah T.

book_ref.quote: These mutations involve exchange of a single nucleotide for another

blocks.prompt:
123 Ionizing radiations such as X rays and gamma rays are mutagenic because they:
(X rays aur gamma rays jaisi ionizing radiations mutation kyun paida karti hain?)

options.text: nucleotides par hydrocarbon groups lagati hain
adenine se amino group hatati hain
atoms ko free radicals mein badalti hain jo DNA ke phosphodiester bonds tor sakte hain

blocks.explanation: Taqatwar ionizing radiation atoms ko free radicals mein badalti hai jo DNA strand ke phosphodiester bonds tor sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Such radiation change atoms into free radicals

blocks.prompt:
